hotels.title: Five-Star Park Hyatt Istanbul Macka Palas Elegance in Upscale Nişantaşı
hotels.description: Occupying the restored Macka Palas in chic Nişantaşı, this refined Istanbul retreat places designer boutiques, art galleries and the leafy paths of Maçka Democracy Park within easy reach. The hotel pairs Art Deco heritage with contemporary interiors, and several rooms and suites feature Bosphorus views. At The Lounge, Turkish and international dishes are served in an elegant setting, while the spa offers a traditional hammam, indoor pool and treatment rooms. A short drive away, Dolmabahçe Palace lines the waterfront, and Teşvikiye’s polished streets are dotted with acclaimed restaurants and stylish cafés
